qualifications.name: USA High School Diploma
qualifications.standard:
Candidates will need to have 3-5 college-level classes. These may include AP, dual enrolment or advanced-level classes.

We look for A grades or equivalent (e.g. AP grade 4 or 5), particularly in subjects related to the course applied to.
qualifications.subject_requirements_standard:
If you are taking AP classes, we require an AP score of 5 in Biology and one of the following:
- Chemistry
- Calculus BC
- Physics 1, 2, C (electricity and magnetism) or C (mechanics).

If your school does not offer APs in these subjects, then we require Grade A in Biology and one of the following:
- Chemistry
- Mathematics
- Physics

qualifications.name: USA High School Diploma
qualifications.standard:
Candidates will need to have 3-5 college-level classes. These may include AP, dual enrolment or advanced-level classes.

We look for A grades or equivalent (e.g. AP grade 4 or 5), particularly in subjects related to the course applied to.
qualifications.subject_requirements_standard:
If you are taking AP classes, we require an AP score of 5 in Biology and one of the following:
- Chemistry
- Calculus BC
- Physics 1, 2, C (electricity and magnetism) or C (mechanics).

If your school does not offer APs in these subjects, then we require Grade A in Biology and one of the following:
- Chemistry
- Mathematics
- Physics

qualifications.name: USA High School Diploma
qualifications.standard:
Candidates will need to have 3-5 college-level classes. These may include AP, dual enrolment or advanced-level classes.

We look for A grades or equivalent (e.g. AP grade 4 or 5), particularly in subjects related to the course applied to.
qualifications.subject_requirements_standard:
If you are taking AP classes, we require an AP score of 5 in Chemistry and one of the following:
- Biology (or Human Biology)
- Computing Science
- Economics
- Geography
- Calculus BC
- Physics 1, 2, C (electricity and magnetism) or C (mechanics).

If your school does not offer APs in these subjects, then we require Grade A in Chemistry and one of the following:
- Biology (or Human Biology)
- Computer Science
- Economics
- Geography Mathematics
- Physics

qualifications.name: USA High School Diploma
qualifications.standard:
Candidates will need to have 3-5 college-level classes. These may include AP, dual enrolment or advanced-level classes.

We look for A grades or equivalent (e.g. AP grade 4 or 5), particularly in subjects related to the course applied to.
qualifications.subject_requirements_standard:
If you are taking AP classes, we require an AP score of 5 in Chemistry and one of the following:
- Biology (or Human Biology)
- Computing Science
- Economics
- Geography
- Calculus BC
- Physics 1, 2, C (electricity and magnetism) or C (mechanics).

If your school does not offer APs in these subjects, then we require Grade A in Chemistry and one of the following:
- Biology (or Human Biology)
- Computer Science
- Economics
- Geography Mathematics
- Physics

qualifications.name: USA High School Diploma
qualifications.standard:
Candidates will need to have 3-5 college-level classes. These may include AP, dual enrolment or advanced-level classes.

We look for A grades or equivalent (e.g. AP grade 4 or 5), particularly in subjects related to the course applied to.
qualifications.subject_requirements_standard:
If you are taking AP classes, we require an AP score of 5 in Calculus BC and one of the following:
- Biology (or Human Biology)
- Computing Science
- Geography
- Chemistry
- Physics 1, 2, C (electricity and magnetism) or C (mechanics).

If your school does not offer APs in these subjects, then we require Grade A in Mathematics and one of the following:
- Biology (or Human Biology)
- Computer Science
- Geography
- Chemistry
- Physics

qualifications.name: USA High School Diploma
qualifications.standard:
Candidates will need to have 3-5 college-level classes. These may include AP, dual enrolment or advanced-level classes.

We look for A grades or equivalent (e.g. AP grade 4 or 5), particularly in subjects related to the course applied to.
qualifications.subject_requirements_standard:
If you are taking AP classes, we require an AP score of 5 in Calculus BC and one of the following:
- Biology (or Human Biology)
- Computing Science
- Geography
- Chemistry
- Physics 1, 2, C (electricity and magnetism) or C (mechanics).

If your school does not offer APs in these subjects, then we require Grade A in Mathematics and one of the following:
- Biology (or Human Biology)
- Computer Science
- Geography
- Chemistry
- Physics

qualifications.name: USA High School Diploma
qualifications.standard:
Candidates will need to have 3-5 college-level classes. These may include AP, dual enrolment or advanced-level classes.

We look for A grades or equivalent (e.g. AP grade 4 or 5), particularly in subjects related to the course applied to.
qualifications.subject_requirements_standard:
If you are taking AP classes, then we require an AP score of 5 in Calculus BC and one of the following: 
- Physics 1, 2, C (electricity and magnetism) or C (mechanics).

If your school does not offer APs in these subjects, then we require Grade A in Mathematics and Physics.
